purpose: Multi-class routing eval for the Artist OS skill family. Each query is labeled with the ONE skill that should win. Used to build a confusion matrix and tune competing descriptions together.
policy: artist-os wins for whole-flow transformations, resume/continue, and cold/ambiguous output-review. A sub-skill wins only when the user clearly asks for one isolated phase on an existing/in-flight project.

evals.query: i wrote this breakup poem last night and i want to turn it into a set of images for my instagram, no idea where to start
evals.rationale: Cold full transformation, no records yet.

evals.query: can we pick back up on the 'tidewrack' project? i think we left off right after the style board
evals.rationale: Resume/continue an existing project.

evals.query: i made this track in suno from my journal entry and something feels off vs what i was going for, can you look at it
evals.rationale: Cold output-review with no loaded records; conductor sets up the Output Record then delegates.

evals.query: turn my grandmother's last letter into a piece of music
evals.rationale: Cold full text->Suno transformation.

evals.query: here's a monologue from a play i'm writing. eventually i want both an image series and a suno track out of it
evals.rationale: Whole multi-medium flow.

evals.query: continue the artist os project for my dream journal, you already have the brief
evals.rationale: Resume.

evals.query: before we do anything else, i just want to log the source. it's a 1998 voicemail transcript from my dad, i own the rights since it's mine
evals.rationale: Explicit isolated reference intake before interpretation.

evals.query: add this reference photo to the project, it's a scan of an old polaroid, not totally sure about the rights
evals.rationale: Isolated intake on an existing project.

evals.query: i don't want to make anything yet. help me get clear on what this poem actually means to me and what has to survive if we change it
evals.rationale: Explicit meaning capture, no production requested.

evals.query: lets just do the meaning part for now. what's the emotional core here, what am i allowed to change, what's off-limits
evals.rationale: Isolated Artist Meaning phase.

evals.query: meaning's locked for the 'ash & salt' piece, now build the image creative brief and the visual prompt plan
evals.rationale: Isolated image planning after meaning exists.

evals.query: i want a triptych for this. can you do the image medium plan and the series plan? the meaning interview is done
evals.rationale: Image planning, meaning already captured.

evals.query: give me the faithful / amplified / minimal prompt variants for the approved image brief
evals.rationale: Post-approval prompt plan is owned by the image planner, NOT the critic.

evals.query: redo just the sound brief for the existing project, i want to push the genre more toward ambient drone
evals.rationale: Isolated sound planning on existing project.

evals.query: write the suno custom-mode prompt and the lyrics now that the sound brief is approved
evals.rationale: Isolated Suno prompt/lyrics phase.

evals.query: before i approve this creative brief draft, can you do the art critic pass on it and deepen it
evals.rationale: Reviews a DRAFT brief pre-approval - the art-critic's exact job.

evals.query: review my sound creative brief document and strengthen it before we lock anything
evals.rationale: art-critic-review covers both visual and sound briefs (sound_critic role).

evals.query: critique these 4 generated images against the approved brief. did they actually keep the meaning
evals.rationale: Output-stage critique of generated work vs approved records.

evals.query: run the prompt critic on my provider-neutral prompt plan and the branch set before i generate
evals.rationale: Prompt Plan / Branch Set critique is critique-asset, not art-critic.

evals.query: review the beat plan for my image series. does each beat actually carry an emotional turn
evals.rationale: Beat Reviewer mode.

evals.query: i drafted the written shape of the final piece, can you review the beats and fragments
evals.rationale: Writing-method review of shape/beats/fragments.

evals.query: can you review my image
evals.rationale: PROBE: ambiguous cold output-review with no project context; policy routes output-review to the conductor. Tests artist-os vs critique-asset vs art-critic collision.

evals.query: review my brief
evals.rationale: PROBE: brief review (not output review) is the art-critic's domain even standalone; tests whether it loses to artist-os.

evals.query: summarize this 30-page PDF research report into bullet points for my monday standup
evals.rationale: Off-domain; no Artist OS skill should win.

evals.query: help me debug why my stripe webhook keeps returning a 400 in the backend repo
evals.rationale: Off-domain near-miss (backend work).

evals.query: i need to write a short artist statement about my painting for a gallery submission this week
evals.rationale: PROBE: art-adjacent and mentions 'artist' + a creative work, but it's prose writing, not the text->art transformation pipeline. A naive keyword match would wrongly fire Artist OS.
